product_metadata.title: SensorPEDIC Wellness Collection Fiber Bed Pillow with Fresh and Clean Infused Fabric Cover, 32202
features: RELEASED AS YOU SLEEP: Through micro-encapsulation, Fresh & Clean scent releases up through your pillowcase as you move during sleep
FRESH SCENT: Fresh scent infused fabric cover promotes a clean & pure feeling
SUPPORTIVE FIBER FILL: Hypoallergenic fiber fill offers plush yet supportive comfort
SUPER SOFT COTTON COVER: Luxurious 300 thread count, all-cotton cover adds a layer of smooth softness
Jumbo size pillow provides head cradling support ideal for all sleep styles
MACHINE WASHABLE FOR LASTING FRESHNESS: In tests, micro-encapsulations show roughly 50% efficacy after 20 washes
description: Discover soothing comfort when sleeping on the Wellness Collection Fresh and Clean Infused Fiber Bed Pillow, featuring a 300 thread count 100% cotton cover that is infused with fresh scent to promote a clean and pure feeling as you sleep. Using micro-capsules encapsulated into the pillow fabric, Fresh and Clean scent is infused into the pillow shell and is released up through your pillowcase and on to your skin. This pillow is generously filled with hypoallergenic fiber that offers plush yet supportive comfort throughout the night. Machine washable for lasting freshness, this Jumbo wellness pillow cradles the head and is ideal for all sleep styles. Note: Scent may not be present when taking out of the packaging. The scent will become stronger as you lay on the pillow.
